section_summary: This section documents efforts by the U.S. State Department, Federal Communications Commission, and diplomatic posts in China and Japan to counter severe radio interference affecting American broadcasts in the Far East during 1939. Primary attention focuses on Japanese stations JZI, JZJ, and local Shanghai station XJOB jamming shortwave transmissions from station KGEI (formerly W6XBE) on Treasure Island, San Francisco, as well as Press Wireless transmissions to Manila. The records include listener complaints, technical monitoring establishing United States priority under international radio agreements, and diplomatic representations made to the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

subfiles.about: Reports complaints from Americans in Peiping regarding Japanese stations JZI and JZJ jamming broadcasts from station KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Lockhart reports JZI and JZJ blotting out KGEI reception in Peiping and recommends making representations to Japanese authorities.
subfiles.title: Peiping Telegram No. 540 on Japanese Interference with KGEI

subfiles.about: Requests details on KGEI registration, assigned frequencies, and international standing prior to making representations.
subfiles.summary: Grew requests complete registration data and international legal basis for KGEI before approaching Japanese authorities.
subfiles.title: Tokyo Telegram No. 520 Regarding KGEI Registration Data

subfiles.about: Instructs Tokyo Embassy to make representations concerning JZI interference with KGEI, citing registration priority under international radio conventions.
subfiles.summary: Hull details KGEI's 1930 priority over JZI, directing representations while advising Tokyo to avoid overly contentious priority arguments.
subfiles.title: State Department Telegram No. 317 to Tokyo on KGEI Priority

subfiles.about: Reports KGEI reception interference in Java caused by foreign warships and an intensified Hong Kong station.
subfiles.summary: Dickover reports Morse interference to KGEI in Batavia from unregistered foreign naval vessels and stronger Hong Kong signals.
subfiles.title: Batavia Telegram on KGEI Interference from Warships and Hong Kong

subfiles.about: Reports Embassy staff is cut off from KGEI news broadcasts due to Japanese interference and seeks permission to protest.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports the Embassy is deprived of KGEI news bulletins and requests expedited permission to approach the Foreign Minister.
subfiles.title: Tokyo Telegram No. 523 Regarding Embassy Reception of KGEI

subfiles.about: Transmits Trade Commissioner A. Viola Smith's memorandum and a press article regarding radio interference in Shanghai.
subfiles.summary: Gauss forwards reports and a journal article on alleged Japanese interference with W6XBE and KGEI broadcasts in Shanghai.
subfiles.title: Shanghai Despatch No. 2486 on Japanese Interference with W6XBE and KGEI

subfiles.about: Summarizes complaints and personal experiences of deliberate Japanese radio jamming against W6XBE news programs.
subfiles.summary: Smith reviews listener complaints and notes intentional jamming occurred during news broadcasts and Ambassador Johnson's speech.
subfiles.title: Memorandum on Radio Interference in Shanghai

subfiles.about: Reports reception conditions of W6XBE on 9530 kc and evening interference from a Japanese station.
subfiles.summary: Swan notes good W6XBE reception except for evening interference from a Japanese station until 8:30 p.m.
subfiles.title: Letter from George Swan Regarding W6XBE Reception

subfiles.about: Details investigations tracing severe shortwave interference with W6XBE to harmonics from Japanese-operated station XJOB.
subfiles.summary: Sullivan identifies XJOB's powerful harmonics as blocking 9530 kc and recounts his visit to its Hardoon Building office.
subfiles.title: Letter from Walter T. Sullivan on Interference from Station XJOB

subfiles.about: Analyzes Japanese military control, censorship, jamming transmitters, and intimidation of commercial radio in Shanghai.
subfiles.summary: Comprehensive report on Shanghai radio under Japanese military occupation. It details the seizure of Chinese stations, deployment of interference transmitters by Major Asano's Superintendence Office, and pressure exerted against foreign stations XMHA and XMHC and commentator Carroll Alcott.
subfiles.title: The Shanghai Broadcasting Situation and Future Prospects

subfiles.about: Reports complaints that a newly active Japanese station, tentatively located at Nagasaki, is blocking KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Lockhart reports KGEI reception in Peiping is blocked by a Japanese station believed to be in Nagasaki.
subfiles.title: Peiping Telegram No. 525 on Interference with KGEI

subfiles.about: Informs the FCC of listener complaints regarding interference to KGEI from Japanese, German, and Hong Kong stations.
subfiles.summary: Messersmith transmits complaints regarding interference with KGEI in China to Fly for any feasible technical assistance.
subfiles.title: State Department Letter to FCC Regarding KGEI Reception in China

subfiles.about: Directs Embassy Peiping to confirm the call letters and frequency of the interfering Japanese station.
subfiles.summary: Department instructs Peiping to urgently confirm call letters and frequency of the interfering Japanese station before making protests.
subfiles.title: State Department Telegram No. 223 to Peiping Requesting Details

subfiles.about: Reports Japanese Ministry of Communications requests data on the receiving strength of stations JDK and KJY in decibels.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports Japan's Ministry of Communications requests decibel signal measurements of JDK and KJY to examine interference.
subfiles.title: Tokyo Telegram No. 548 on Press Wireless Interference

subfiles.about: Inquires whether the FCC can measure the comparative receiving strength of stations JDK and KJY at Manila.
subfiles.summary: Messersmith asks Fly if the FCC can ascertain comparative signal strength of JDK and KJY in Manila.
subfiles.title: State Department Letter to FCC on JDK and KJY Signal Strength

subfiles.about: Requests assistance from the Philippine Commonwealth in ascertaining comparative signal strengths of JDK and KJY at Manila.
subfiles.summary: Messersmith requests Ickes enlist Philippine authorities to measure signal strengths of JDK's second harmonic and KJY at Manila.
subfiles.title: State Department Letter to Secretary of the Interior on Manila Radio Interference

subfiles.about: Reports presentation of a formal memorandum to the Japanese Foreign Office regarding radio interference with KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports delivering a memorandum to the Japanese Foreign Office based on Department instructions concerning KGEI interference.
subfiles.title: Tokyo Telegram No. 552 on Presentation of Memorandum to Foreign Office

subfiles.about: Informs Consulate General Shanghai that instructions were telegraphed to Tokyo and directs forwarding of local reports.
subfiles.summary: Department notifies Shanghai of diplomatic instructions sent to Tokyo and directs forwarding of Despatch 2486 to Tokyo.
subfiles.title: State Department Telegram No. 419 to Shanghai Directing Exchange of Data

subfiles.about: Records Shanghai telegram reporting stations JZI, JZK, and ZBW blotting out KGEI broadcasts.
subfiles.summary: File note recording Shanghai telegram No. 918 regarding stations JZI, JZK, and ZBW blotting out KGEI.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Shanghai Telegram No. 918

subfiles.about: Records Shanghai telegram conveying Technical Committee conclusion that KGEI reception requires frequency changes by JZI and ZBW.
subfiles.summary: File note recording Shanghai telegram No. 920 reporting satisfactory KGEI reception is impossible while JZI and ZBW remain on frequency.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Shanghai Telegram No. 920

subfiles.about: Affirms U.S. registration priority on 9530 kc and transmits monitoring reports showing severe heterodyne interference from JZI.
subfiles.summary: Fly confirms KGEI's legal priority and submits monitoring reports from Honolulu and San Pedro proving severe interference from JZI.
subfiles.title: FCC Letter to Secretary of State on KGEI Priority and Monitoring

subfiles.about: Records intra-departmental coordination regarding forwarding Shanghai's despatch on station XJOB to Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Adams informs Hamilton that Shanghai was directed to mail Tokyo a copy of its despatch concerning station XJOB.
subfiles.title: Division of Far Eastern Affairs Memorandum on Station XJOB

subfiles.about: Discusses station XJOB harmonic interference and advises against raising XJOB with Japan at present.
subfiles.summary: Burke reviews XJOB interference and rebroadcasting prospects, recommending withholding XJOB data while Tokyo addresses station JZI.
subfiles.title: Memorandum on Japanese Radio Interference and Rebroadcasting in Shanghai

subfiles.about: Reports personal shortwave intercepts of Tokyo broadcasts concerning Japanese military movements, cabinet policy, and European affairs.
subfiles.summary: A Kansas farmer reports news intercepts from Tokyo stations JZJ and JZK regarding Japanese military actions in China and naval moves toward Malaya. He urges State and FCC officials to monitor these transmissions and offers to share current broadcast schedules.
subfiles.title: Handwritten Letter from Earl Nicholas Regarding Japanese Broadcasts

subfiles.about: Provides a typed transcript of Earl Nicholas's letter reporting Japanese shortwave broadcasts and offering schedule charts.
subfiles.summary: Departmental typed transcript of Nicholas's letter reporting broadcasts from JZJ and JZK on Japanese military policy and offering schedules.
subfiles.title: Typewritten Transcript of Letter from Earl Nicholas

subfiles.about: Acknowledges receipt of Earl Nicholas's letter regarding foreign radio propaganda directed toward the United States.
subfiles.summary: Burke thanks Nicholas for his letter, noting Japanese broadcasting schedules are periodically available to the Department.
subfiles.title: Department of State Letter to Earl Nicholas

subfiles.about: Recommends sending a courteous, noncommittal acknowledgment to Earl Nicholas for his monitoring report.
subfiles.summary: Otterman summarizes Nicholas's report on JZJ and JZK, recommending a brief noncommittal reply in appreciation of his good faith.
subfiles.title: Memorandum Regarding Letter from Earl Nicholas

subfiles.about: Transmits Commerce Department inquiry asking Shanghai to telegraph available facts regarding Japanese stations blanketing KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Department forwards Commerce request instructing Shanghai to report any available facts regarding Japanese blanketing of KGEI.
subfiles.title: State Department Telegram No. 409 to Shanghai Requesting Facts

subfiles.about: Requests naval radiogram transmission of a message to the Commercial Attaché in Shanghai regarding KGEI interference.
subfiles.summary: Commerce Department transmittal form requesting radiogram transmission to Shanghai regarding Japanese radio interference with KGEI.
subfiles.title: Request for Transmittal of Cablegram to Shanghai

subfiles.about: Summarizes systematic monitoring in Shanghai demonstrating that stations JZI and ZBW severely blot out KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Arnold summarizes technical tests showing JZI and Hong Kong station ZBW obliterating KGEI evening broadcasts in Shanghai.
subfiles.title: Shanghai Telegram No. 918 on Technical Monitoring of JZI and ZBW

subfiles.about: Relays Technical Committee conclusion that KGEI reception cannot improve unless JZI and ZBW change frequencies, urging diplomatic action.
subfiles.summary: Arnold reports Technical Committee findings that KGEI reception will remain impossible unless representations induce JZI and ZBW to shift frequencies.
subfiles.title: Shanghai Telegram No. 920 Recommending Representations

subfiles.about: Reports continuing severe interference with KGEI and inquires regarding official remedial efforts.
subfiles.summary: Arnold reports persistent interference with KGEI and asks what efforts are underway through the FCC or diplomatic channels.
subfiles.title: Shanghai Telegram No. 966 Inquiring on Remedial Action

subfiles.about: Informs Shanghai that diplomatic representations were made in Tokyo on October 25 and are being followed closely.
subfiles.summary: Department advises Shanghai that representations were made in Tokyo on October 25 regarding KGEI interference, with results awaited.
subfiles.title: State Department Telegram No. 435 to Shanghai Reporting Representations

subfiles.about: Transmits Press Wireless field strength measurements in Manila showing harmonic interference from station JDK against KJY.
subfiles.summary: Fly provides field strength measurements from Manila showing station JDK's second harmonic interfering with Press Wireless station KJY.
subfiles.title: FCC Letter to Secretary of State on JDK and KJY Field Strength

subfiles.about: Informs the FCC that Manila monitoring data was forwarded to Tokyo for urgent diplomatic representations.
subfiles.summary: Messersmith informs Fly that Manila field strength data was cabled to Tokyo to demand elimination of JDK harmonic interference.
subfiles.title: State Department Letter to FCC on Tokyo Instructions Regarding JDK

subfiles.about: Instructs Tokyo Embassy to present Manila monitoring data to Japanese authorities and demand elimination of JDK second harmonic interference.
subfiles.summary: Department instructs Tokyo to present Manila signal measurements to Japanese officials and urge suppression of JDK's second harmonic.
subfiles.title: State Department Telegram No. 348 to Tokyo on JDK Interference

subfiles.about: Reports Portland monitoring data showing station JZI operating off-frequency and causing a severe 3 kc heterodyne with KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Fly transmits Portland monitoring data demonstrating JZI operates below its assigned frequency with illegal deviation, creating severe heterodyne interference.
subfiles.title: FCC Letter to Secretary of State on JZI Frequency Deviation

subfiles.about: Informs the FCC that instructions detailing JZI frequency deviations are being telegraphed to Embassy Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Messersmith informs Fly that Tokyo was instructed to bring JZI's illegal frequency deviation and heterodyne interference to Japanese attention.
subfiles.title: State Department Letter to FCC on Tokyo Instructions Regarding JZI

subfiles.about: Instructs Tokyo Embassy to present FCC monitoring data showing JZI operates consistently below assigned frequency.
subfiles.summary: Department directs Tokyo to present Portland monitoring data to Japanese authorities, protesting JZI's excessive frequency deviation and heterodyne interference.
subfiles.title: State Department Telegram No. 347 to Tokyo on JZI Frequency Deviation

subfiles.about: Transmits listener reports, technical correspondence, and press clippings documenting Japanese interference with KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Gauss transmits extensive reports and letters collected by Trade Commissioner Smith and J. B. Powell documenting deliberate Japanese interference.
subfiles.title: Shanghai Despatch No. 2622 on Japanese Interference with KGEI

subfiles.about: Reports formation of the Treasure Island Interference Committee and records personal monitoring of JZJ/JZK jamming KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Smith describes Powell's technical monitoring committee and recounts personal observations of station JZJ deliberately drowning out KGEI news.
subfiles.title: Letter on Formation of Treasure Island Interference Committee

subfiles.about: News report on Shanghai and Manila listener complaints regarding Japanese stations blanketing KGEI broadcasts.
subfiles.summary: Article reports Shanghai and Manila complaints that Japanese broadcasts on KGEI's frequency prevent reception of American news.
subfiles.title: Local Americans Ask Probe of Alleged West Coast Broadcast Jam by Japanese

subfiles.about: News article reporting Japanese press conference statements denying intentional interference and claiming frequency rights.
subfiles.summary: Article reporting a Japanese spokesman's denial of intentional interference, assertion of legal wavelength allocations, and refusal to alter frequencies.
subfiles.title: Japanese Deny Interference with Treasure Island

subfiles.about: Instructs Tokyo Embassy to expedite the Japanese government's reply to representations regarding KGEI interference.
subfiles.summary: Department instructs Tokyo to press Japanese authorities for an expedited reply to representations concerning station JZI.
subfiles.title: State Department Telegram No. 393 to Tokyo Urging Reply

subfiles.about: Transmits copy of the diplomatic memorandum presented to the Japanese Foreign Office protesting JZI interference with KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Grew transmits a copy of the formal memorandum presented to the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs regarding KGEI interference.
subfiles.title: Tokyo Despatch No. 4203 Transmitting Memorandum to Foreign Office

subfiles.about: Diplomatic memorandum asserting United States priority for KGEI under international agreements and requesting cessation of JZI interference.
subfiles.summary: Embassy memorandum cites KGEI's 1930 priority under the Washington Convention and emphasizes its unique value to Far East Americans, requesting Japanese cooperation.
subfiles.title: American Embassy Memorandum to Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs

subfiles.about: Reports admonishing Commercial Attaché Williams regarding an indiscreet letter written by his wife to station W6XBE.
subfiles.summary: Official informs Hamilton of warning Commercial Attaché Williams that his wife must not write further indiscreet letters to W6XBE.
subfiles.title: Letter to Maxwell M. Hamilton Regarding Mrs. Williams's Letter to W6XBE
